private.name: Walden Robotics

data.narrative:
Westmag is a Seed-stage robotics and manufacturing company founded by David Hansen and Jordan Sanders that has raised $11M to date. The sector comp universe includes one public peer (277810.KQ) and eight private companies, among them Walden Robotics, Divergent, Exotec, Locus Robotics, and Generalist AI.

The Stage-Progression method is the primary applicable valuation lens. Using total capital raised as a proxy for current value and applying a 2.5x multiplier typical of Seed-to-next-stage progression yields an implied valuation of $28M. A peer-median approach was not feasible due to insufficient same-stage or adjacent-stage comparables within the robotics sector—only one narrow-set peer exists at Seed stage, falling below the minimum threshold of three datapoints needed for reliable cross-sectional benchmarking. While ten robotics and manufacturing peers exist broadly, filtering by stage and valuation tier eliminated median-based triangulation.

The analysis supports a valuation range of $23M to $32M, with a median point of $28M. This range reflects a ±15% sensitivity band around the stage-progression result. Key uncertainties include the representativeness of the 2.5x Seed multiplier to Westmag's specific risk profile and market timing, and the absence of direct peer validation. Given the single-method foundation, updated pricing should incorporate new comparable transactions or disclosed financials from the robotics sector.
